description: Configure the Vrbo scraper to search vacation rentals by destination, dates, and guest count. Returns property details, prices, ratings, amenities, host info and images.

adults.description: Number of adult guests. Affects pricing and availability.
adults.title: Number of Adults

checkIn.description: Check-in date in YYYY-MM-DD format. If left empty or in the past, the scraper will use today + 30 days automatically.
checkIn.title: Check-in Date

checkOut.description: Check-out date in YYYY-MM-DD format. If left empty or in the past, the scraper will use check-in + 2 days automatically.
checkOut.title: Check-out Date

children.description: Number of child guests. Affects pricing and availability.
children.title: Number of Children

destination.description: Destination city, region or area to search (e.g., 'Orlando, FL', 'Paris, France', 'Miami Beach').
destination.title: Destination

maxItems.description: Maximum number of properties to scrape from search results.
maxItems.title: Maximum Properties

proxyConfiguration.description: Required. Vrbo is Akamai-protected and blocks all datacenter IPs. Must use Apify RESIDENTIAL proxy group with country US (requires a paid Apify plan). The default prefill already configures this.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration

title: Vrbo Vacation Rentals Input
